text:
alex: quick RFC follow-up — sketching a lifecycle state machine for offline package handling: thinking NEW -> STAGED -> VALIDATED -> ACTIVATING -> ACTIVE -> OBSOLETE. trying to capture operator backoffs, coalescing, and safe rollbacks. thoughts?

claudia: nice. do we need a TRANSIENT_FAILED state? activation can fail due to flakey disk or network and we want automatic retries rather than immediate rollback.

alex: agreed. add TRANSIENT_FAILED. proposing backoff policy: max_retries=5, base=2s, max_backoff=10m, jitter=uniform(0,0.25). operator should emit metrics per attempt.

sam: cross-node coalescing question — if many nodes try to activate the same bundle at once, we should avoid duplicated fetches. leader election per-bundle/region?

leo: leader election feels heavy for airgapped on-prem. lighter approach: randomized activation windows (splay) + per-bundle in-memory/file lock to serialize fetch->extract. simple and robust.

claudia: splay + per-bundle lock + local dedupe cache works. also require idempotent apply semantics: partial-extract markers and resume logic on restart.

alex: agree. operator will write a .extracting marker, extract to temp dir, then atomic rename to final path. on startup, reconcile finds markers and resumes or cleans up.

maria: telemetry: operator should attach trace_id to steps (fetch -> verify -> extract -> activate) so support can correlate failures. also alert if activation_latency > 5m on 3+ nodes in same cluster.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: @alex opened RFC #0009: "offline package lifecycle and backoff patterns" (draft) — https://r.rw/rfcs/0009 :eyes:

sam: verifier timeouts: remote signing/KMS checks might hang in airgapped installs when a proxy or shuttle is unreachable. propose short auth timeout (15s) for online checks + long background retries. allow activation to proceed using an offline signature cache if policy allows.

alex: add policy flag: allow_offline_trusted_cache: true|false. default false for regulated/enterprise installs. good call.

claudia: rollback semantics: how do we recover from a partial activation? need tombstone/rollback_marker referencing previous manifest and a safe apply order for component dependencies.

leo: propose activation-transaction: only swap active symlink after all component health checks pass for a short observation window (e.g., 30s). if health-checks fail, leave previous symlink and emit rollback plan.

maria: express observation as: success_count >= N && within_window <= T. document N/T defaults and how operators should surface them.

alex: rough operator pseudocode and config snippet below. this is intentionally small but should capture the core:

```yaml
backoff:
  max_retries: "5"
  base_seconds: "2"
  max_seconds: "600"
  jitter: "0.25"

activation_coordinator:
  splay_seconds: "0..300"  # randomized activation window to avoid thundering-herd
  observation_window_seconds: "30"
  required_success_count: "3"

state_transitions:
  NEW: [STAGED]
  STAGED: [VALIDATED, TRANSIENT_FAILED]
  VALIDATED: [ACTIVATING, TRANSIENT_FAILED]
  ACTIVATING: [ACTIVE, TRANSIENT_FAILED]
  TRANSIENT_FAILED: [ACTIVATING, OBSOLETE]
```

claudia: perf note: operator should batch fetches when bundles share layer blobs and store content-addressed blobs to dedupe across bundles. avoids large disk churn.

sam: metrics to expose: activation_latency_seconds{bundle,region,node_id,policy}, activation_attempts_total{bundle,region}, activation_last_result{bundle,node}. also expose verify_latency and extract_latency.

alex: will add those metric names to RFC. also propose events: ActivationStarted, ActivationSucceeded, ActivationFailed(reason), ActivationRolledBack.

maria: don't forget RBAC docs: which service account permissions are required to seed caches, write symlinks, rotate keys. ops/sre will need these for audits.

sam: test matrix ideas:
- single-node cold install
- parallel-activation 50 nodes with splay
- partial-failure during extract (simulate disk full)
- verifier-unreachable but offline-cache-allowed
- abrupt reboot during ACTIVATING -> resume

leo: can we add an integration smoke that runs activation then intentionally fails health-checks to validate rollback path?

alex: yes — add e2e where we flip a fake-health-check endpoint. will include in PR.

claudia: one more: make per-bundle manifests content-addressed and include upstream-proof metadata (signatures + timestamp) so operator can detect replays.

alex: thanks — i'll fold notes into RFC and open a PR with operator pseudocode + tests. tagging @maria for RBAC and @sam for metrics review. :thumbsup:

maria: will draft RBAC snippet after PR lands.

sam: i'll stub out Prometheus metric names and an example dashboard.
